Configure Preprocessing Recipe for a TMLE Specification

Source: R/tmle_spec.R
set_preprocessing.Rd

Attaches a base recipes::recipe to a tmle_spec(). During fitting, tidytmle automatically clones and adapts this recipe per nuisance factor (Q, g, C) so treatment \(A\) is never leaked into propensity models and id/censoring/weights columns are excluded from predictors.

Usage

set_preprocessing(spec, recipe)

Arguments

spec

A tmle_spec() object.

recipe

A recipes::recipe object (or NULL to revert to automatic formula preprocessing).

Value

An updated "tmle_spec" object.

Examples

df <- sim_causal_cohort(n = 120, seed = 1)
rec <- recipes::recipe(y ~ ., data = df) |>
  recipes::step_dummy(recipes::all_nominal_predictors())
spec <- tmle_spec(y, a, c(age, sex, lab_1)) |>
  set_preprocessing(rec)
spec
#> 
#> ── Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation (TMLE) Specification ──
#> 
#> • Outcome to measure: y
#> • Treatment / exposure: a
#> • Confounders adjusted for: c(age, sex, lab_1)
#> • Causal question(s): "ate"
#> • Cross-fitting: TRUE (10-fold out-of-sample)
#> • Safety guardrails: bounds = "adaptive" | calibration = "logistic"
#> Next: pass to fit(data = your_data) to estimate causal effects.
